description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit them.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit. Read-only.
  save --message SUBJECT [--body BODY] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit it.

Flags:
  review: --max-file-lines max diff lines shown per file, default 150; --max-lines max lines of output overall, default 3000.
  save: --message is REQUIRED and must be a single non-empty line; --body optional commit body, may span multiple lines; --dry-run reports what would be staged and committed and changes nothing.

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["review", "--max-file-lines", "40", "--max-lines", "800"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB meeting and flush buffer", "--body", "Added a meeting note, two actions and three hours entries."]
  ["save", "--dry-run", "--message", "Log SGB meeting and flush buffer"]

Notes:
  Run `review` first and write --message from what it actually shows; never summarise blind.
  `save` stages every change in the vault, not a selected subset. It can only ever add a commit — it never amends, rebases, resets, checks out, or pushes.
  `review` truncates long diffs; a truncated file is still fully committed by `save`.
  Exit code 1 on: an empty --message; a --message spanning more than one line; the vault root not being a directory or not being the root of its git repository; a failing git call.
